introHtml: Poly spandex fabric offers a comfortable, stretchy feel that makes it ideal for promotional gift sets and bundles. Whether you're assembling wellness kits with custom headbands and wristbands or creating branded travel sets with eye masks, the four-way stretch ensures one-size-fits-most comfort. This material holds vibrant dye sublimation prints, allowing full-color logos that won't crack or peel. Perfect for corporate events, trade shows, or employee appreciation packages where recipients expect quality and a soft touch.
heroAltText: Custom poly spandex gift sets bundles with full-color printed logos, including headbands and wristbands for corporate events.
